1.web: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
1.asv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

2.web: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
2.asv: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

3.web: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.
3.asv: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.

4.web: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
4.asv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

5.web: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.
5.asv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who isthe help of my countenance, and my God.
